title: 1.3 Compound proportions, rates of work and mixtures

q.Q1: Q1. Solve the hook problem: how many masons are needed to finish in 4 days?

q.Q2: Q2. 12 machines produce 3600 bottles in 5 hours. How many bottles would 8 machines produce in 6 hours?

q.Q3: Q3. Pipe A fills a tank in 6 h and pipe B in 3 h. How long do they take together?
q.Q4: Q4. A tap fills a tank in 4 h; a leak empties it in 12 h. How long to fill the tank with the leak open?

q.Q5: Q5. Rice at KSh 120/kg is mixed with rice at KSh 180/kg so that the mixture costs KSh 140/kg. Find the ratio.
q.Q6: Q6. A trader sells the mixture at KSh 175/kg. Find the percentage profit.

q.Q7: Q7. After 4 days, 3 of the original 6 masons leave. How many more days do the remaining 3 masons take to finish the wall?
